title: Rapid synthesis of phosphomolybdic acid encapsulated ZIF-8 for efficient uranium(VI) capture from alkaline solution
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,36365-36379
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA06854A, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Abdelaal S. A. Ahmed, El Sayed A. Haggag, Mohamed F. Cheira, Ahmed A. Abdelsamad, Ashraf M. Abdel-lateef
Phosphomolybdic acid hydrate (PMA) encapsulated within a ZIF-8 framework (PMA@ZIF-8) was synthesized and utilized for U(VI) adsorption from the alkaline leach liquor of dolostone material collected from SW Sinai.
